import json
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.engine.io import write_json, file_digest, digest
from nisayon.engine.temporal_workflow import load_assessment
from scripts.experiments.audit_temporal_reconciliation import archive_packet
root = Path("artifacts/engine-integration-001/temporal-integration-001/combined-deadline-001")
target = Path("docs/experiments/results/temporal-integration-001")
assessment = load_assessment(root / "assessment", root / "execution")
rows, events_by_pair = [], {}
for item in assessment["assignments"]:
    assignment = item["assignment"]
    trace = json.loads((root / "execution/assignments" / assignment["id"] / "trace.json").read_bytes())
    events = trace["events"]
    detail = json.loads((root / "assessment" / item["detail"]["path"]).read_bytes())
    row = {"assignment": assignment, "complete_record": item["complete_record"], "integrity": item["integrity"], "events_sha256": digest(events), "dispatches": [e for e in events if e["kind"] == "action_dispatched"], "admissions": [e for e in events if e["kind"] == "queue_admitted"], "refusals": [e for e in events if e["kind"] == "dispatch_refused"], "acknowledgements": [e for e in events if e["kind"] == "dispatch_acknowledged"], "reference_assessment": detail["reference_assessment"], "legacy_contract": item["temporal_contract"], "assigned_contract": item["assigned_contract"], "original_execution_costs": item["original_execution_costs"], "read_assess_write_costs": item["read_assess_write_costs"]}
    rows.append(row)
    events_by_pair[(assignment["case_id"], assignment["remedy_id"])] = events
ties = []
for case in json.loads((root / "execution/frozen-suite.json").read_bytes())["cases"]:
    left = events_by_pair[(case["id"], "conventional_combined_deadline")]
    right = events_by_pair[(case["id"], "selected_combined_deadline")]
    ties.append({"case_id": case["id"], "exact_event_equality": left == right, "events_sha256": digest(left)})
archive = archive_packet(root, target / "combined-deadline-001.tar.gz")
report = {"schema": "nisayon.temporal-combined-deadline-result.v1", "source_commit": "819016ce0292f421051d1aa13a3a0175a574041f", "evaluation_delivery": "8e5465051a583823ce8bf3914846e71046fbdeee", "capture": json.loads((root / "capture.json").read_bytes()), "capture_command": "f2c0a2cb064e4243ab433fa7b6ee4e95", "execution_export_command": "b731063504454f0199abf41722b78fc9", "not_executed_attempt": {"command": "71460e7af4e442f694baefab13b1499a", "process_status": "completed", "semantic_outcome": "no_execution_or_artifacts", "explanation": "The command wrapper does not forward stdin; python - received no program. Empty stdout and no output directory were checked before the actual capture. This is not a second execution or success.", "wall_seconds": 0.030549}, "rows": rows, "combined_arm_pairs": ties, "archive": archive, "saved_assessment_verified": True, "scope": "All 24 exposed software assignments, including C02 and Y02 readings still pending owner disposition. Full raw bytes, independent assessments and historical nested costs retained. No robot progress, product advantage or pooled repair rate."}
write_json(target / "combined-deadline-001.json", report)
print(json.dumps({"assignments": len(rows), "exact_combined_event_pairs": sum(t["exact_event_equality"] for t in ties), "archive_bytes": archive["bytes"], "readback_verified": True, "rows": [{"id": r["assignment"]["id"], "sent": [e["value"] for e in r["dispatches"]], "refused": [e["reason"] for e in r["refusals"]], "assigned": r["assigned_contract"]} for r in rows]}, indent=2))
assert len(rows) == 24 and all(t["exact_event_equality"] for t in ties)
